definitions.gloss: low quality; poor quality; inferior quality
definitions.explanation: A low standard of quality — of goods, services, content, or work. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier meaning low-quality or inferior.

examples.japanese: {低品質|ていひんしつ}の{商品|しょうひん}。
{値段|ねだん}が{安|やす}くても、{低品質|ていひんしつ}ならすぐ{壊|こわ}れる。
examples.english: Even if it's cheap, a low-quality product will break quickly.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、ネット{上|じょう}には{低品質|ていひんしつ}な{情報|じょうほう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, low-quality information has been increasing online.

examples.japanese: {低品質|ていひんしつ}な{部品|ぶひん}を{使|つか}うと、{製品|せいひん}{全体|ぜんたい}の{信頼性|しんらいせい}が{下|さ}がってしまう。
examples.english: Using low-quality parts reduces the reliability of the whole product.

notes:
Composed of {低|てい} (low) and {品質|ひんしつ} (quality). Describes goods, services, content, or work of inferior standard. The direct antonym is {高品質|こうひんしつ} (high quality).

USAGE:
- As a noun: {低品質|ていひんしつ}が{問題|もんだい}だ (the low quality is a problem)
- As a の-modifier: {低品質|ていひんしつ}の{部品|ぶひん} (low-quality parts)
- Also used as a な-adjective: {低品質|ていひんしつ}な{情報|じょうほう} (low-quality information)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}な{商品|しょうひん}: a low-quality product
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}のサービス: poor-quality service
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}コンテンツ: low-quality content (often online)
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve poor quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}: high quality — the direct antonym
- {粗悪|そあく}: poor, shoddy — stronger and more negative; often implies deliberately inferior goods
- {劣悪|れつあく}: inferior, abysmal — even stronger; used for conditions or quality that is dangerously bad
- {安物|やすもの}: cheap thing — refers to the product itself rather than its quality level
